decisions.question: Which Fourier pairs, representation, modes, location, alignment boundary, capacity, trials, outcomes, controls, and success rule apply?
decisions.rationale: Diagonal Fourier characters are the algebraic support of modular sum, and replacing that code before the MLP output projection asks the recipient's downstream computation to realize a donor abstract value as its own counterfactual behavior.

recommendation.aggregation: within comparison set, aligned minus each control on the primary outcome; then teacher-seed paired summaries separately by phase and hard/soft condition
recommendation.alignment: fit source and recipient linear task-code subspaces and an orthogonal Procrustes map in float64 on the fixed training-domain split only; deterministic SVD/sign convention; no test trials or outcome logits enter fitting
recommendation.capacity: same ordered support of four complex modes/eight real degrees of freedom with identical conjugate bookkeeping, fitted rank, float32 write precision, recipient write budget, identifier count, and side-information bytes for aligned plus all five controls
recommendation.expected_behavior: the intervened recipient should move from its intact base behavior toward its own intact behavior on the canonical counterfactual input, changing the predicted result from s to s_d while preserving the recipient network's centered-logit pattern for that counterfactual
recommendation.interchanged_variable: the projected internal code for the modular sum s=(x+y) mod p on the four primary diagonal harmonics
recommendation.internal_location: final-token blocks.0.mlp.hook_post, after the nonlinear MLP activation and before W_out writes into the residual stream
recommendation.intervention_formula: h_rec_intervened = h_rec_base - P_rec(h_rec_base) + A(P_src(h_src_donor)), at the frozen MLP-post location; P_rec and P_src are fixed fitted task-code projections and A is the fixed capacity-bounded source-to-recipient alignment
recommendation.location_justification: modular-addition task variables are expected to be synthesized in nonlinear MLP features; intervention before W_out tests an internal causal state and leaves the recipient's W_out, residual addition, normalization, and unembedding to translate that state into behavior
recommendation.mode_justification: for any function g(x+y mod p), the 2-D Fourier transform is supported on the diagonal frequency pairs (k,k) under the frozen negative-exponent DFT convention because character_k(x+y)=character_k(x) character_k(y); the first four nonzero diagonal harmonics are fixed without observing activations or outcomes
recommendation.pair_rule: for each seed 0-14, each primary phase, and each hard/soft condition, source is the direct teacher and recipient is the lowest fixed initialization slot that is eligible; if none is eligible the pair is unavailable and is not replaced

primary_outcome.centering: C subtracts the per-input class mean
primary_outcome.interpretation: 1 is exact recipient-counterfactual behavior; 0 is no displacement from intact base; negative values are retained
primary_outcome.name: counterfactual_centered_logit_displacement_fidelity
primary_outcome.zero_denominator: trial unavailable and reported, never epsilon-regularized

recommendation.representation: unitary 2-D DFT over the ordered modular input grid; complex coefficients stored as ordered real/imaginary pairs with conjugate partners implied by real activations
secondary_outcomes: base-behavior preservation on matched no-change trials
recommendation.success_rule: shared-causal-abstraction claim eligible only when aligned exceeds every one of the five controls under the predeclared teacher-seed interval rule, counterfactual argmax is favorable, no-change preservation passes, and the comparison inventory is complete; otherwise not_met, indeterminate, or unavailable
recommendation.trial_construction: recipient base input is (x,y); donor input is (x_d,y_d) with donor sum s_d different from base sum s; the canonical recipient counterfactual is (x, (s_d-x) mod p), preserving the recipient first operand while changing only the abstract sum to s_d
recommendation.trial_inputs: 256 fixed canonically ordered recipient/donor trials per comparison set and condition; no replacement
recommendation.why_causal_abstraction: the donor contributes only an internal sum-code variable; the recipient's downstream weights must causally realize the donor sum as the recipient's own counterfactual behavior. Matching donor output logits or patching the final residual is neither the intervention nor the target.
recommendation.wrong_mode_separation: off-diagonal support is disjoint from the primary diagonal support, has the same number of complex modes and real degrees of freedom, and is never used to fit, rank, or amend the primary mode subspace

recommendation.balance_rule: fixed assignments are balanced by seed order, phase, condition, and architecture/basis; unavailable cells remain unavailable with no replacement
recommendation.optional_increment_rule: each task increment has its own sealed manifest/hash; after protected completion is secure, admit only the next increment when measured remaining capacity can finish it; a terminal failure is retained and never replaced

combinatorial, ordinary-restart, and local calibration minimum

decisions.stage11_direction: Sparse tiered crossing; no full factorial; optional work never displaces protected work.
decisions.stage12_evidence: P3 validates injected tiers, priorities, dependencies, protected shedding, resource-neutral execution, retries, and incomplete campaign records.
decisions.uncertainty: Optional tasks are excluded from launch feasibility. Their task-specific convergence and throughput remain Stage 14 measurements; insufficient optional capacity yields non-admission, not protected-core failure.

viable_options.description: Large protected Task 1 canonical matrix plus a bounded architecture/basis/Task 2/tractable/Fourier Tier 2 minimum.
viable_options.tradeoff: Directly addresses every red-team repair but creates a visible launch blocker if the intended envelope is insufficient.

viable_options.description: Protect only the canonical Task 1 matrix and make all external validity optional.
viable_options.tradeoff: Cheaper but weakens accepted red-team repairs.

viable_options.description: Full factorial.
viable_options.tradeoff: Prohibited and pseudo-replicated.

decisions.amendment_consequence: Stage 14 may bind only enumerated provider facts and qualified concurrency; changing scientific DAG, priority, retry semantics, retention, gates, or export verification requires a Stage 13 amendment.
invalid_options: retry a scientific failure with changed settings
delete scratch before destination hash verification

protected_tier_consequences.tier1: Highest priority and never shed for optional work; a capacity projection below Tier 1 blocks Stage 14 launch.
protected_tier_consequences.tier2: Protected minimum released only under the primary-completeness gate.
protected_tier_consequences.tier3: Runs only from remaining capacity in fixed order.

decisions.question: Which Stage 13 scientific DAG, retry, retention, gate, capacity-branch, and export policies are frozen before Stage 14 supplies provider facts?
decisions.rationale: The policy freezes scientific orchestration while explicitly refusing to invent provider facts; transient retries cannot mutate logical scientific identity.

actual_resource_binding: provider/scheduler and account only if actually available
machine count and hardware class for every worker
qualified CPU, CUDA, or MPS status per hardware class
minimum-of-three post-warmup training, model-loop hard-concrete, and exact-evaluation throughput
host CPU cores reserved per active accelerator
per-machine availability intervals and permitted hours
queue latency, preemption behavior, and measured scheduling efficiency
recommendation.export: sealed bundle to a Stage 14 verified destination, resumable transfer, independent byte/hash verification, and no source deletion
recommendation.gate_visibility: only completeness, failures, resources, storage, and integrity; no comparative scientific direction
recommendation.launch_blocker: if no verified configuration completes the protected core within H_science, block launch pending prospective amendment
recommendation.optional_admission: Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5; only after protected completion is secure and only when the entire next manifest increment fits measured remaining capacity

capacity_equations: training_capacity = sum over machines and intervals of qualified_training_rate * usable_interval_seconds * measured_efficiency
hard_concrete_capacity = analogous sum using model-in-loop rate
exact_capacity = analogous sum using standalone CPU exact rate
host CPU support reservations are subtracted before standalone CPU capacity is computed
school_mac_branch.hardware_classes: class k records machine count M_k, CPU cores, RAM, optional MPS device, and disk quotas
school_mac_branch.optional_rule: after protected completion is secure, admit Task 3, then Task 4, then Task 5 only when measured remaining interval capacity can finish the entire next increment
school_mac_branch.pass_rule: protected core must finish within H_science with memory/storage quotas and audit reserve intact; otherwise launch blocks
school_mac_branch.permitted_hours: availability intervals I_{k,m}; capacity is integrated over intervals, never count*nominal wall time
school_mac_branch.qualified_rates: r_train_cpu[k], r_hc_cpu[k], r_exact_cpu[k], and optional r_train_mps[k]/r_hc_mps[k] only after exact and semantic MPS qualification
school_mac_branch.schedule_rule: run the dependency-closed protected DAG against actual intervals; CPU-only is mandatory when MPS is absent or unqualified

recommendation.scientific_dag: complete dependency-closed P3 manifest generated from approved RD-001 through RD-012 values

scientific_window.stage14_binding: H_total = total qualified permitted hours across verified availability intervals

decisions.stage11_direction: One automated campaign with launch, primary-completeness, and exit gates; provider/container/path/quota facts remain Stage 14.
decisions.stage12_evidence: P3 provides resource-neutral DAG/retry/state semantics; P4 provides deterministic gzip compact records, quotas, retention, merge, bundle, transfer resume, and destination verification. The v3 accounting separates accelerator device-hours, host support reservation, standalone CPU work, weak CPU critical path, compact retention, active scratch, and retry/staging worst case.
decisions.uncertainty: No provider, institution, accelerator count, CPU count, MPS status, uninterrupted window, or quota is presumed. Stage 14 must bind all such facts and block if the protected core cannot finish.

viable_options.description: Bind actual Stage 14 machine inventory, hardware classes, availability intervals, qualified CPU/CUDA/MPS rates, quotas, and permitted hours; require protected-core completion and keep optional tasks ordered.
viable_options.tradeoff: Conservative and auditable; actual concurrency and paths remain a Stage 14 blocker.

viable_options.description: No retries and 6-hour audit reserve.
viable_options.tradeoff: Lower duplicate work but more fragile to transient infrastructure faults.

viable_options.description: Embed assumed Symbolica queue/path/container values now.
viable_options.tradeoff: Prohibited because none has been supplied and verified.

deferred_decisions.reason: Actual CPU/CUDA qualification, numerical drift, resume equivalence, environment lock, and abort rule require the real backend. Stage 9 CPU/MPS evidence is technical only and CUDA is unmeasured.

settings selected to strengthen a phase or distillation contrast

historical Phase I context only where admitted by the protocol
Stage 9 and Stage 10 technical runtime, memory, determinism, and storage evidence

documented intended four-day resource envelope, explicitly not a verified grant
